tool_args.rationale: All pilot observations are positive and stop at H=0.48, far short of the H=22.5 forecast target. The H=20 probe tests whether slow adaptation reverses the response and gives the subsequent fit leverage to estimate the slow timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows mainly constrain the ratio of adaptation amplitude to slow time constant, not the two parameters separately.
Finer sampling is less useful than a targeted long-horizon measurement for distinguishing slow adaptation from a transient short-window effect.
The auxiliary measurement does not resolve the slow adaptation ambiguity.
